en.headline: Police hunt man who stole HK$10,000 from claw machines with a key
en.dek: A man in his thirties opened deposit boxes at four machines in a Tai Kok Tsui shop on Sunday morning and fled with the cash, police said.
body: Hong Kong police are searching for a man who used a key to steal about HK$10,000 from four claw machines at a shop on Tai Kok Tsui Road on Sunday.

The store owner, a 46-year-old man surnamed Cheung, reported the incident at around 11.10am after reviewing surveillance footage. He said he saw a man in his thirties open the deposit boxes of four machines and leave with the money.
Police said they are working to identify the man and determine how he obtained the key. The case has been classified as theft.

zh.headline: 大角咀夾公仔機被用鎖匙盜走約一萬元 警方追緝男子
zh.dek: 店主周日上午透過閉路電視錄影片段，目睹一名男子打開四部機的投幣箱取走現金後離開。
body: 警方正追緝一名男子，涉嫌周日在大角咀道一間店舖，用鎖匙打開四部夾公仔機的投幣箱，盜走約一萬元現金。
店主張姓男子（46歲）約上午11時10分報案，指他查看閉路電視後，見到一名三十多歲男子打開四部機的投幣箱取走款項後離開。
警方表示正追查該名男子身分，並調查他如何取得鎖匙，案件列作盜竊處理。
